observation.setting: A white-walled studio space, likely for a fitness video production.
observation.dancers: Three dancers in the main instructional group (one woman, two men); later, three dancers in full regalia (two men, one woman) join.

observation.cannot_infer: The video is a fast-paced instructional edit; the exact weight transfer and footwork details are obscured by the quick cuts and camera angles.

signature_moments.what: The 'hip/cross' move: lifting one knee while crossing the opposite arm across the body.
The 'lunge/punch' move: stepping forward into a lunge while extending the opposite arm in a punch.
The 'step n' circle' move: stepping in a small circle while maintaining a rhythmic, high-stepping gait.
